runtime_input_policy.copyright_rule: Image 1 supplies exact product identity. Image 2 is the 4:5 scene-condition authority for camera, measured pair geometry, cup assembly when selected, round wood support, diffuse light topology, plant support and local color separation. Transfer only the exact companion phrase CAFE AMERICANO; never transfer the foreground cafe-latte drink or label.

allowed_style_features: one exact user beverage in the measured front-left primary slot
one smaller generic double-nested white paper cup behind-right
one round pale matte live-edge wood table matching material and grain scale but using a new edge contour, grain phase and crack topology
one broad diffuse upper-left rear window source with lower-right broad penumbrae
neutral-gray exterior and warm-local wood separation
one small distant low-detail potted plant supported by the broad white interior sill and clearly separated in depth
the exact understated companion-cup text CAFE AMERICANO following paper-cup curvature
forbidden_copy_features: reference latte or Americano recipe and exact ice layout
the words cafe latte or any primary-label heading other than exact lowercase cafe
any text outside the adopt-reference cafe label and the companion phrase CAFE AMERICANO

asymmetry_sources: front-left exact product and smaller behind-right companion
partial window context and irregular live-edge table crop
micro_moments: a quiet cafe order resting naturally beside a softly lit window

tone_contract.background_plane: soft gray exterior and pale sill separated from the warmer wood foreground
tone_contract.color_bias: local beige-brown wood warmth with neutral white cups and cool gray window context
tone_contract.highlight_behavior: broad rolled highlights on cup rims, ice and condensation with no clipped plastic or paper

main_subject.role: one exact user beverage in the measured raw-3:4 front-left slot

secondary_subjects.role: one generic double-nested white paper cup Americano with rich natural crema and exact small CAFE AMERICANO text

composition.shot_type: close environmental tabletop pair matching the sanitized scene-condition scale
composition.camera_angle: slightly above both rims at a controlled twenty-to-twenty-five degree downward pitch
composition.camera_height: approximately one hundred five to one hundred twenty-five centimeters
composition.horizon_visibility: a diagonal bright sill and restrained cool-gray exterior band remain readable
composition.depth_of_field: both cup bodies, rims, ice and contacts resolve; only plant and exterior microdetail recede
composition.alignment: measured front-left primary and smaller behind-right companion on the same round wood plane

lighting.type: one very large diffuse window source with neutral sill and room bounce
lighting.direction: upper-left and slightly behind toward lower-right
lighting.intensity: subdued protected daylight at minus 0.20 to minus 0.04 EV
lighting.contrast: low one-source contrast matched to Image 2 with broad transitions, open brown-gray shadows and no direct sun
lighting.shadow: small attached base contacts followed by broad soft lower-right penumbrae at 118-150 degrees
lighting.highlight_control: neutral paper and window whites roll below clipping; transparent highlights remain broad and interrupted

color.temperature: 4850-5100K subdued warm-neutral daylight matched to Image 2; warmth remains local to wood
color.saturation: low-saturation reference screen color with source-authoritative product color protected
color.contrast: soft separated midtones, open toe and broad gentle highlight shoulder matching Image 2
color.black_point: neutral brown-gray black with wood pore, paper fiber and beverage separation

scene.surface: one round pale matte live-edge wood table retaining only material class and grain scale; generate a new edge contour, grain phase, ring flow and crack topology rather than tracing the scene hint
scene.background: diagonal bright window sill, cool-gray exterior and one small low-detail plant in a matte pot visibly supported by the interior sill
props: one double-nested paper-cup Americano carrying exact small CAFE AMERICANO text
scene.texture: matte pale wood pores with the dark mark at the table's 10 o'clock area reduced to 30% of the reference contrast so it reads as faint grain, never mold; paper fibers, physically irregular ice, natural crema and nonuniform condensation

capture.look: quiet natural cafe phone photograph with soft spatial depth
capture.realism: one camera, one exposure and one diffused daylight system physically join both drinks and the table
capture.grain: faint low-contrast luminance texture with finite social-photo acuity
imperfections: small crema bubbles on the companion Americano
subtle wood grain and edge variation

hard_lock: primary remains front-left with 0.015-0.025 center drift and 2-4% scale variation while its cup geometry remains locked
companion remains smaller behind-right with 0.02-0.035 center drift and 3-5% scale variation while its double-cup geometry remains locked
one smaller behind-right generic companion made from two visibly nested paper cups
one round pale matte live-edge wood table
one broad diffuse upper-left rear window source with no direct sun or gobo
4850-5100K reference-matched separation with wood-only local warmth
exact small text CAFE AMERICANO on the companion only, optically wrapped to the paper-cylinder curvature
adopt-reference mode preserves one off-white rectangular paper label with exact lowercase cafe heading and tiny English body copy; preserve-source mode never adds it
small plant pot visibly supported by the interior sill; never emerging from a frame seam or gap
editable: placeholder drink is always replaced by the exact user beverage
minor generic ice and crema arrangement
minor non-identifying leaf micro-shape while pot support and origin remain fixed
reference_exclusions: the words cafe latte and all source beverage identity
all text except the conditional adopt-reference cafe label and exact companion phrase CAFE AMERICANO

prompt_blocks.input_roles: Image 1 is exact product identity. Image 2 is mandatory scene-condition authority for measured composition, selected reference-cup assembly, table geometry, diffuse light field, shadow topology and local color separation.
prompt_blocks.composition: Treat the measured bboxes as soft scale anchors: independently vary primary and rear companion position/scale within the approved corridors while retaining front-left/behind-right hierarchy, diagonal-sill depth, a distant sill-supported plant and round-table support through the 4:5 crop.
prompt_blocks.look: Match Image 2 screen color and exposure: one broad upper-left rear diffuse window, low saturation, gentle shoulder, open brown-gray shadows, warm-local matte wood, neutral-gray exterior and no direct sun.
prompt_blocks.preservation: Fully rerender Image 1 beverage, cup, ice, refraction, condensation, transmission, contact and cast shadow as one target-scene exposure. Always preserve exact companion text CAFE AMERICANO. In adopt-reference mode preserve the rectangular cafe paper label and tiny English body copy; in preserve-source mode omit that label.
prompt_blocks.negative: No oversized product, tiny companion, single paper cup, flat crema, unsupported plant, frame-gap growth, hard sunlight, spotlight, amber wash, glossy wood, portrait bokeh, floating base, sticker-like product, geometric ice or airbrushed liquid.

quality_gates.logo_text: only source-authoritative user-product text plus the required exact companion phrase CAFE AMERICANO may remain; no other scene text or logo is allowed
quality_gates.product_identity: exactly one user beverage preserves recipe color and serving state; preserve-source keeps the source container, while adopt-reference discards it and reconstructs the declared clear PET cup
quality_gates.preset_adherence: approved scale and position corridors, front-left/behind-right hierarchy, double nested companion, supported distant sill plant, authorized curved text, diagonal-sill depth, round-table support, broad one-source diffuse light and 4850-5100K reference screen color pass together
quality_gates.artifact_policy: reject wrong relational scale, single companion cup, unsupported plant, incorrect CAFE AMERICANO text, direct sun, mismatched contacts, flat crema, synthetic ice, glossy wood, global amber grade, sticker-like product, copied foreground content or a scene clone retaining the same wood cracks, plant, exterior and pair coordinates

failure_recovery: restore both measured raw-3:4 bboxes before changing aesthetics
restore the second visible paper rim and natural crema
restore one broad diffuse window source and 118-150 degree soft shadow flow
restore neutral-gray exterior and wood-only local warmth
restore source product identity and remove placeholder content or unauthorized text
